```vbnet
Public Function IsRectangleCover(rectangles As Integer()()) As Boolean
    Dim area As Integer = 0
    Dim lx As Integer = Integer.MaxValue
    Dim ly As Integer = Integer.MaxValue
    Dim rx As Integer = Integer.MinValue
    Dim ry As Integer = Integer.MinValue
    Dim points As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)

    For Each rectangle As Integer() In rectangles
        Dim x As Integer = rectangle(0)
        Dim y As Integer = rectangle(1)
        Dim a As Integer = rectangle(2)
        Dim b As Integer = rectangle(3)

        lx = Math.Min(lx, x)
        ly = Math.Min(ly, y)
        rx = Math.Max(rx, a)
        ry = Math.Max(ry, b)

        area += (a - x) * (b - y)

        Dim p1 As String = x.ToString + "," + y.ToString
        Dim p2 As String = a.ToString + "," + y.ToString
        Dim p3 As String = a.ToString + "," + b.ToString
        Dim p4 As String = x.ToString + "," + b.ToString

        If points.ContainsKey(p1) Then
            points(p1) += 1
        Else
            points(p1) = 1
        End If

        If points.ContainsKey(p2) Then
            points(p2) += 1
        Else
            points(p2) = 1
        End If

        If points.ContainsKey(p3) Then
            points(p3) += 1
        Else
            points(p3) = 1
        End If

        If points.ContainsKey(p4) Then
            points(p4) += 1
        Else
            points(p4) = 1
        End If
    Next

    If area <> (rx - lx) * (ry - ly) Then
        Return False
    End If

    For Each point As KeyValuePair(Of String, Integer) In points
        If point.Value <> 2 And point.Value <> 4 Then
            Return False
        End If
    Next

    Dim p1 As String = lx.ToString + "," + ly.ToString
    Dim p2 As String = rx.ToString + "," + ly.ToString
    Dim p3 As String = rx.ToString + "," + ry.ToString
    Dim p4 As String = lx.ToString + "," + ry.ToString

    If Not points.ContainsKey(p1) Or Not points.ContainsKey(p2) Or Not points.ContainsKey(p3) Or Not points.ContainsKey(p4) Then
        Return False
    End If

    Return True
End Function
```
